project_type: Python Telegram bot (aiogram + LangGraph RAG pipeline)
build_system: uv (package manager), Makefile targets for common commands
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), pytest-xdist for parallel, pytest-timeout=30s
test_command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 uv run --python 3.12 pytest tests/unit/ --ignore=tests/unit/test_document_parser.py --ignore=tests/unit/test_evaluator.py --ignore=tests/unit/evaluation/test_ragas_evaluation.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_sip_setup.py --ignore=tests/unit/voice/test_voice_agent.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_cocoindex_init.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_helpers.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_qdrant_hybrid_target_state_paths.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_target_sync_execution.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_cli.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow.py --ignore=tests/unit/ingestion/test_unified_flow_wiring.py -n auto --dist=worksteal -q --timeout=30 -m 'not legacy_api and not requires_extras and not slow'
verification_instructions:
1. Run focused test file: uv run pytest <path/to/test_file.py> -q
2. Run make check (lint/format/types)
3. Run make test-unit (full unit suite parallel)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode. Python 3.12 recommended. No Docker needed for unit tests. No live services needed (all mocked).
contribution_requirements: Test-first workflow from skills/superpowers. Use Arrange/Act/Assert. Mock external APIs. Tests in tests/unit/. File naming: test_<feature>.py. Test naming: test_<behavior>_<expected_outcome>(). Anti-duplication: search existing tests before adding. Verification: focused run then make check + make test-unit.
key_patterns: PropertyBot instantiation pattern: _create_bot() helper patches Bot, CacheLayerManager, BGEM3HybridEmbeddings, BGEM3SparseEmbeddings, QdrantService, GraphConfig.create_llm, GraphConfig.create_supervisor_llm. BotConfig with _env_file=None for test isolation. Callback mocks: MagicMock with AsyncMock for answer/get_data/update_data. State mock: MagicMock with get_data=AsyncMock returning dict, update_data=AsyncMock. pytest.importorskip('aiogram') at top of test files. conftest.py provides mock_get_client and isolate_otel_langfuse autouse fixtures.
directory_structure: telegram_bot/ - main bot code (bot.py is 5395 lines, PropertyBot class). tests/unit/ - unit tests (200+ existing). tests/unit/handlers/ - handler-specific tests. telegram_bot/handlers/ - extracted router handlers. telegram_bot/services/ - business logic. telegram_bot/integrations/ - wrappers/adapters. telegram_bot/graph/ - LangGraph pipeline.
